avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces UGT1A1, significantly reducing raltegravir plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent UGT1A1 inducer decreases raltegravir levels by approximately 40-60%
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; if TB treatment necessary, increase raltegravir dose to 800 mg twice daily

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (>1000 mg/dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate raltegravir and reduce absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours; take raltegravir 2 hours before or 6 hours after calcium

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor viral load if co-administered

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May modestly increase raltegravir absorption and peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: No dose adjustment needed; consistent timing with or without food is acceptable

monitoring_notes: Raltegravir has minimal hepatic metabolism, making it one of the safest antiretrovirals for interactions. Monitor viral load and CD4 count regularly; counsel patients on medication adherence as resistance can develop with subtherapeutic levels, particularly with UGT1A1 inducers.
